title: OpenReview Full Agentic Platform and Safe PR Merge
domain: Rust, GitHub Apps and Actions, secure agentic coding

intent.problem: OpenReview has three stacked open PRs with green CI but outstanding production/security readiness, and its desired human/bot conversation, project playbook and advanced multi-file coding features need verified implementation.
intent.desired_outcome: Land the existing PR stack only when all security and deployment gates pass; ship Actions BYOK and self-hosted App; then deliver an interactive, project-aware multi-file coding agent, with independently implemented semantic review as a later milestone.
intent.actor: Mamdouh, repository owner, directing coding agents

in: Revalidate PR #1, #2 and #3 and safely merge after blockers are resolved
BYOK provider and deployment paths for GitHub Actions and self-hosted GitHub App
PR context, comment/review/bot interaction and idempotent webhook routing
Project skill use with proof and typed playbook execution
Bounded multi-file review, Fix, test and trusted publisher
Independent semantic entity-level review research and gated implementation
out: Auto-execution of arbitrary PR, bot or skill instructions with secrets
Production infrastructure managed by GitHub outside Actions
Claims of exhaustive vulnerability detection or unauthorized copying from Inspect
constraints: Respect current GitHub branch protection and approval requirements
TDD with reproducible red/green tests and current-SHA evidence
Fail closed on missing vulnerability details, tenant identity or publisher permissions
No credentials in repo, shell logs, PR comments, model prompts outside configured provider

facts: 2026-10-29 snapshot: PR #1 is open non-draft, #2 and #3 are open draft; each is CLEAN and associated CI was green at recorded head SHA
Qlty status text reported open blockers: #1 five including three vulnerabilities, #2 four including one, #3 one; details have not been independently inspected
Live OpenCode Custom/Gemini Actions E2E in openreview-e2e-lab run 40809709032 was successful for one authorized Fix path
Rust source includes agent runner, PR diff snapshot, GitHub webhook verification, skills discovery, model adapters, sandbox, Actions and publisher
A prior PR description held merge pending verified multi-install App and rootless production host evidence
GitHub issue #4 captures independent semantic review inspiration
assumptions: Repository owner can arrange authorized test installations and select an App hosting operator
Existing Rust code and CI remain an appropriate baseline, subject to live revalidation
Real provider keys will be supplied by each user via standard secret configuration rather than embedded in this specification
unknowns: Current PR and CI state after the dated snapshot
Exact Qlty finding details and current branch protection settings
Actual multi-install App runtime evidence and available hosting infrastructure
Exact per-provider live key availability beyond the tested OpenCode route
Parser/library choice and measured value for semantic analysis

decisions.decision: One Rust core supports GitHub Actions BYOK and self-hosted GitHub App
decisions.rationale: Keep review/fix behavior consistent across hosting modes

decisions.decision: Trusted publisher is separate from uncredentialed agent worker
decisions.rationale: Protect installation tokens and reduce prompt injection impact

decisions.decision: PR comments, bots and repository skills are data, not authorization
decisions.rationale: Do not turn untrusted text into tool privileges
Respect the observed Inspect license and require independent evaluation

workstreams.name: M0: PR blockers and safe merge
workstreams.outcome: Reproducible App/security gates pass and stacked PRs land on main

workstreams.name: M1: Actions and App release
workstreams.outcome: Tested deployment and four BYOK provider routes

workstreams.name: M2: PR conversations and bots
workstreams.outcome: Complete causal context, verified mention routing and loop control

workstreams.name: M3: Skills and playbooks
workstreams.outcome: Deterministic discovery and evidence-backed policy-restricted execution

workstreams.name: M4: Full coding agent
workstreams.outcome: Bounded multi-file Fix with independent verification and safe publish

workstreams.name: M6: Semantic review
workstreams.outcome: Independent symbol graph and measured risk review benefit

deliverables: Verified merge and CI evidence per PR
GitHub Action BYOK install template and provider matrix
Self-hosted App deployment, lifecycle and security documentation
Conversation graph, skills/playbooks contracts and tests
Multi-file coding agent with bounded policy and trusted publication
E2E security matrix and independent semantic benchmark
risks: Unverified Qlty blockers and App E2E prevent safe merge
GitHub Actions fork/event secret handling may cause privilege leakage if designed incorrectly
External bot comments and repository skill text can be prompt-injection sources
GitHub token event semantics can leave a pushed commit without new CI
Semantic parsing can omit dynamic dependencies and inflate confidence

success_criteria: All M0 gates pass for exact current head SHAs before merge; main remains green
At least two independent App installations validated for isolation and revocation
Actions BYOK OpenCode live E2E plus fixture suite for OpenRouter, Anthropic, OpenAI
End-to-end threaded PR comment and bot loop tests pass
Skills/playbooks show observed application evidence and fail closed on privilege requests
Authorized multi-file Fix publishes only verified patch and reports checked SHA
Semantic findings show measured precision/recall and explicit parser coverage
evidence: GitHub PR/check URLs recorded in BASELINE_AND_EVIDENCE.md are past evidence only
Current merged SHA, CI run IDs and Qlty triage required at execution time
Test IDs and evidence ledger specified in TEST_AND_EVIDENCE_MATRIX.md

blockers: Obtain exact Qlty findings/approvals and two-install App safety evidence before any current merge
next_action: Start M0-01 as read-only discovery: re-query PR #1/#2/#3 heads, current CI and reviews; collect authorized Qlty findings and an App multi-install test environment.
